Sidekick now uses one interaction engine for the custom characters: tap for a reaction, double tap to switch character, hold for a special reaction, swipe left or right to make it follow you, swipe up to wake it and swipe down to put it to sleep. Motion Sense presence, reach, flick and swipe are supported too. Your double-tap character choice is remembered.
Google Pokémon stays on Google’s original renderer and keeps the original Pokémon character artwork. Custom Sidekicks use the enhanced Sidekick engine. Both use the Pixel 4 Motion Sense stack.
